messages.english: Your damage is reflected back at you!
messages.translation: 你的伤害被反射回了你身上！

messages.english: One of the Royal Jelly's fragments survives.
messages.translation: 皇家胶怪的一块碎片存活了下来。

messages.english: You feel extremely nervous for a moment...
messages.translation: 你有一瞬间感到极度紧张……

messages.english: Your orb flickers with a hungry flame!
messages.translation: 你的宝球闪烁着饥渴的火焰！

messages.english: You consecrate your suffering and invoke the rites of blood!
messages.translation: 你将苦难奉为献祭，施行鲜血仪式！

A flurry of magic pours from %s injured body!
messages.translation: 一阵魔力从%s的受伤的身躯中倾泻而出！

messages.translation: 你的召唤盟友被留在了原地。

messages.english: Your mindless puppets stay behind to rot.

messages.english:
There is an existing game for name '%s' from an incompatible version of Crawl (%s).
Unless you reinstall that version, you can't load it.
Do you want to DELETE that game and start a new one?
messages.translation:
已有名为“%s”的游戏存档，来自不兼容的 Crawl 版本（%s）。
需要重新安装该版本才能载入。
要删除该存档并开始新游戏吗？

messages.english:
You already have %s game saved under the name '%s';
do you want to load that instead?
messages.translation:
已有一个%s模式的游戏保存在“%s”名下；
要改为载入该游戏吗？

messages.english:
This game comes from a previous release of Crawl (%s).

If you load it now, you won't be able to go back. Continue?
messages.translation:
该游戏来自较早的 Crawl 版本（%s）。

现在载入后将无法再用旧版本打开。继续吗？

messages.english: %s is from an incompatible version and can't be loaded.
messages.translation: “%s”来自不兼容的版本，无法载入。

messages.english: Please use a different name to start a new %s game, then.
messages.translation: 请使用其他名字开始新的%s模式游戏。

messages.english: Please use version %s to load %s then.

This Lava Orc save game cannot be loaded as-is. If you load it now,
your character will be converted to a Mountain Dwarf. Continue?
messages.translation:
这个熔岩兽人存档无法原样载入。现在载入将把角色转换成山地矮人。
继续吗？

messages.english: Please load the save in an earlier version if you want to keep it as a Lava Orc.
messages.translation: 如需保留熔岩兽人角色，请使用旧版本载入存档。

messages.english:
This Vampire save game cannot be loaded as-is. If you load it now,
your character will be converted to a Human. Continue?
messages.translation:
这个吸血鬼存档无法原样载入。现在载入将把角色转换成人类。
继续吗？

messages.english: Please load the save in an earlier version if you want to remain a Vampire.
messages.translation: 如需保留吸血鬼角色，请使用旧版本载入存档。

messages.english: The air sparks with electricity, shocking %s%s
messages.translation: 空气中迸发电火花，电击了%s%s
你现在是敏捷的织网者。

messages.english: You are a living statue of rough stone.
messages.translation: 你现在是粗石构成的活雕像。

messages.english: You were a living statue of rough stone.
messages.translation: 你曾是粗石构成的活雕像。

messages.english: You are an enormous two-headed serpent.
messages.translation: 你现在是巨大的双头蛇。

messages.english: You were an enormous two-headed serpent.

messages.translation: 你现在是不死的恐怖存在。
你曾是不死的恐怖存在。
你现在是虚无缥缈的幽火。
你曾是虚无缥缈的幽火。

messages.english: You are a lump of jelly.
You were a lump of jelly.

messages.translation: 你现在是有感知的真菌。

messages.english: You are a swirling mass of dark shadows.
messages.translation: 你现在是翻涌的暗影团。

messages.english: You were a swirling mass of dark shadows.

messages.translation: 你现在是充满闪电的风暴！
你曾是充满闪电的风暴！

messages.english: You are covered in sharp quills.
messages.translation: 你现在浑身覆盖着尖锐的棘刺。

messages.english: You were covered in sharp quills.
messages.translation: 你曾经浑身覆盖着尖锐的棘刺。

messages.english: You are a creature with a mouth for a stomach.
messages.translation: 你现在是以巨口代替胃的生物。

messages.english: You were a creature with a mouth for a stomach.
messages.translation: 你曾是以巨口代替胃的生物。
你现在是危险而不稳定的存在。
你曾是危险而不稳定的存在。

messages.english: You are a vessel of demonic slaughter.
messages.translation: 你现在是恶魔屠戮的化身。

messages.english: You were a vessel of demonic slaughter.
messages.translation: 你曾是恶魔屠戮的化身。
你现在是活着的吸血鬼。

messages.english: You are a swarm of vampire bats.
messages.translation: 你现在是一群吸血蝙蝠。

messages.english: You were a swarm of vampire bats.

messages.translation: 你现在是覆满坚冰的牦牛。
你曾是覆满坚冰的牦牛。
你现在是狡黠的斯芬克斯。
你曾是狡黠的斯芬克斯。
你现在是披着重甲的蟹。

messages.english: You are a gleaming scarab beetle.
messages.translation: 你现在是闪耀的圣甲虫。

messages.english: You were a gleaming scarab beetle.
You are overflowing with transmutational energy.
messages.translation: 你的身体充满了变形能量。

messages.english: You were overflowing with transmutational energy.
messages.translation: 你的身体曾充满变形能量。

messages.english: You have blades growing out of your body.
You had blades growing out of your body.
Your body is made of elemental water.
messages.translation: 你的身体由元素之水构成。

messages.english: Your body was made of elemental water.
messages.translation: 你的身体曾由元素之水构成。

messages.english: You have a mane of long, stinging tendrils on your head.
messages.translation: 你的头上长着一丛细长的刺螫触须。

messages.english: You had a mane of long, stinging tendrils on your head.
messages.translation: 你的头上曾长着一丛细长的刺螫触须。

messages.english: You sometimes web enemies you hit.
messages.translation: 你击中敌人时有时会用蛛网缠住他们。

messages.english: You can move swiftly towards enemies.
You can leap distances in the blink of an eye.
messages.translation: 你能在眨眼间跃过一段距离。

messages.english: You are stealthy and inflict bonus damage to unaware enemies.
messages.translation: 你善于潜行，对未察觉你的敌人造成额外伤害。
你容易受到毒素伤害。（毒抗-）

messages.english: You can perform multiple auxiliary attacks with your blades.
messages.translation: 你能用刀刃进行多次辅助攻击。

messages.english: You gain SH while attacking, based on your slaying.
messages.translation: 你在攻击时根据杀戮加成获得格挡值。
你的近战攻击威力强大。

messages.english: You are resistant to unholy torment.
All of your actions are slow.
messages.translation: 你的所有行动都很缓慢。

messages.english: You have a powerful constriction melee attack.
messages.translation: 你拥有强力的近战绞缠攻击。

messages.english: You can wear a hat or helmet on each head.
messages.translation: 你的每个头都能戴一顶帽子或头盔。

messages.english: You have a powerful clawing attack.
Your giant scaled body is strong and resilient, but less evasive.
messages.translation: 你巨大的鳞片身躯强壮坚韧，但不够灵活。

messages.english: Your melee attacks drain, slow and weaken victims.
messages.translation: 你的近战攻击会吸能、减速并削弱受害者。

messages.english: You can torment nearby foes to heal from their wounds.
messages.translation: 你能折磨附近的敌人，从他们的创伤中获得治疗。

messages.english: You are immune to unholy pain and torment.
messages.translation: 你免疫邪恶的痛苦和折磨。

messages.english: You recover more slowly from Doom and Banes.
messages.translation: 你从厄运和厄咒中恢复得更慢。

messages.english: You are tiny, dextrous, and very evasive.
messages.translation: 你体型微小，动作灵巧，很难被击中。

messages.english: Your unarmed attacks are very weak.
Your bark is very hard, but your evasion is minimal.
messages.translation: 你的树皮十分坚硬，但你几乎无法闪避。

messages.english: Your unarmed attacks smack enemies forcefully with your branches.
messages.translation: 你的徒手攻击会用树枝猛烈抽打敌人。

messages.english: You are immune to unholy torment.
Your roots penetrate the ground, keeping you stationary.
messages.translation: 你的根须深入地面，使你无法移动。

messages.english: You are insubstantial and cannot be petrified, ensnared, or set on fire.
messages.translation: 你的身躯虚无缥缈，无法被石化、缠困或点燃。

messages.english: You are highly resistant to most damage types. (rF++, rC++, rN+++, rElec, rCorr)
messages.translation: 你对大多数类型的伤害都有很高的抗性。（火抗++、冰抗++、负能量抗性+++、电抗、腐蚀抗性）

messages.english: You are resistant to acid and immune to corrosive walls.
messages.translation: 你能抵抗酸液，且免受腐蚀墙壁的影响。

messages.english: Your amorphous body is immune to blinding, drowning, and ensnarement.
messages.translation: 你无定形的身体免疫致盲、溺水和缠困。

messages.english: Your melee attacks splash acid on your foes.
messages.translation: 你的近战攻击会向敌人泼洒酸液。

messages.english: You cast all spells with heavily decreased power.
messages.translation: 你的所有法术威力都大幅降低。

messages.english: Your melee attacks release spores that confuse breathing creatures.
messages.translation: 你的近战攻击释放的孢子会使需要呼吸的生物混乱。

messages.english: You become terrified and freeze when enemies are visible.
messages.translation: 有敌人在视野内时，你会因恐惧而僵住。

messages.english: Damage taken is halved, but you are drained when taking damage.
messages.translation: 你受到的伤害减半，但受伤时会受到吸能。

messages.english: You bleed smoke when taking damage.
Your spells are much less powerful.
messages.translation: 你的法术威力大幅降低。

messages.english: You can devour living enemies to heal.
messages.translation: 你能吞噬活着的敌人来治疗自身。

messages.english: Your electrical attacks strike out in all directions at once.
messages.translation: 你的电击会同时攻击各个方向。

messages.english: You can turn into living lightning.
Your quills sometimes injure those who attack you in melee.
messages.translation: 你的棘刺有时会刺伤近战攻击你的敌人。

messages.english: Your maw can bite with vicious strength.
messages.translation: 你的巨口能够凶猛地撕咬。

messages.english: You can devour enemies to increase your regeneration.
messages.translation: 你能吞噬敌人来提高再生速度。

messages.english: Your maw sometimes becomes mesmerised by tasty morsels.
messages.translation: 你的巨口有时会被美味的食物迷住。

messages.english: Your maw has eaten a hole through body armour, reducing its AC.
messages.translation: 你的巨口咬穿了躯干防具，使其护甲值降低。

messages.english: Foes you strike become dangerously contaminated with transmutational energy.
messages.translation: 被你击中的敌人会受到危险的变形能量污染。

messages.english: You glow with energy, making you easy to see.
messages.translation: 你散发能量光芒，很容易被发现。
你受到的伤害减少三分之一。
你通过击杀获得的治疗翻倍。

messages.english: You will endure the Crucible once your slaughter is complete.
messages.translation: 屠戮结束后，你将承受血肉熔炉的考验。

messages.english: Your fangs allow you to drain the lifeblood from your enemies.
messages.translation: 你的尖牙使你能够吸取敌人的生命之血。

messages.english: When you kill a living creature with a stab, you may create a vampiric thrall.
messages.translation: 你刺杀活物时，有机会创造吸血奴仆。

messages.english: You can occasionally transform into a swarm of bats.
messages.translation: 你偶尔能够变成蝙蝠群。

messages.english: You often daze monsters when they first notice you.
messages.translation: 怪物刚察觉到你时，经常会被你震慑。

messages.english: You do not regenerate when monsters are visible.
messages.translation: 有怪物在视野内时，你无法再生。

messages.english: You freeze nearby walls in an area that expands as you fight.
messages.translation: 你会冻结附近的墙壁，战斗时范围逐渐扩大。

messages.english: You can cast Ice magic more easily.
messages.translation: 你能更容易地施放冰系魔法。

messages.english: When at low health, angry bees swarm out to defend you.
messages.translation: 生命值较低时，愤怒的蜜蜂会蜂拥而出保护你。

messages.english: You regenerate HP and MP more quickly.
messages.translation: 你的生命值和魔法值恢复得更快。

messages.english: Your aqueous body allows to you attack from a distance.
messages.translation: 你的水体使你能够从远处攻击。

messages.english: When injured, pools of shallow water form around you.
messages.translation: 受伤时，你周围会形成浅水池。

messages.english: You can command nearby water to drown your enemies.
messages.translation: 你能驱使附近的水淹没敌人。

messages.english: When hit by fire damage, your body sometimes produces steam.
messages.translation: 受到火焰伤害时，你的身体有时会产生蒸汽。

messages.english: When hit by cold damage, your body sometimes freezes.
messages.translation: 受到寒冷伤害时，你的身体有时会冻结。

messages.english: You unleash cutting winds upon enemies you strike.
messages.translation: 你会向击中的敌人释放割裂之风。

messages.english: Hexes are much easier for you to cast and harder to resist.
messages.translation: 你更容易施放妖术系魔法，敌人也更难抵抗它们。

messages.english: You often pose riddles to enemies when you first see then.
messages.translation: 初次看到敌人时，你经常会向他们出谜语。

messages.english: You gain temporary slaying when you kill enemies in melee.
messages.translation: 你在近战中击杀敌人时，会获得临时杀戮加成。

messages.english: You sometimes unleash a terrifying howl when you kill enemies in melee.
messages.translation: 你在近战中击杀敌人时，有时会发出恐怖的嚎叫。

messages.english: You can leap to fearful enemies and eviscerate them.
messages.translation: 你能跃向恐惧中的敌人，将其开膛破肚。

messages.english: You have increased skill with all magical schools.
messages.translation: 你所有魔法学派的技能都得到提高。

messages.english: Your melee attacks sometimes restore your MP.
messages.translation: 你的近战攻击有时会恢复魔法值。

messages.english: You cannot cast spells above level 4.
messages.translation: 你无法施放高于4级的法术。

messages.english: Your melee attacks are very weak.
Your body armour is fused into your shell, improving its AC and properties.
messages.translation: 你的躯干防具与甲壳融合，提高其护甲值及属性。

messages.english: You can exhale clouds of rust.
You manifest a globe of solar heat that you carry with you.
messages.translation: 你会显现出一颗随你移动的太阳热球。

messages.english: Your solar ember damages enemies next to it every second time you attack.
messages.translation: 你每攻击两次，太阳余烬就会伤害其身边的敌人。

messages.english: You heal your solar ember whenever you swap places with it.
messages.translation: 你与太阳余烬交换位置时会治疗它。

messages.english: Your melee attacks sometimes make enemies vulnerable to fire.
messages.translation: 你的近战攻击有时会使敌人变得易受火焰伤害。

messages.english: You can cast Fire magic much more easily.
messages.translation: 你能更容易地施放火系魔法。

messages.english: Your tendrils poison nearby enemies when you attack.
messages.translation: 你攻击时，触须会使附近的敌人中毒。

messages.english: When significantly injured, you may petrify poisoned enemies.
messages.translation: 受到重创时，你可能会石化中毒的敌人。

messages.english: Electricity sometimes discharges through enemies you attack.
messages.translation: 你攻击敌人时，有时会释放穿过敌人的电流。

messages.english: When badly injured, your eels discharge electricity violently.
messages.translation: 受到重创时，你的电鳗会猛烈放电。

messages.english: Your melee attacks may weaken breathing enemies.
messages.translation: 你的近战攻击可能会削弱需要呼吸的敌人。

messages.english: Your melee attacks cause explosive burstshrooms to grow.
messages.translation: 你的近战攻击会使能够爆炸的爆裂蘑菇生长。

messages.english: Your %s is a mass of colorful fungus.
messages.translation: 你的%s变成了一团彩色真菌。

messages.english: Your %s was a mass of colorful fungus.
messages.translation: 你的%s曾变成一团彩色真菌。

messages.english: shudders and is absorbed by its neighbour.
